results.title: What’s New At Husky Stadium In 2026
results.description: SEATTLE – Washington football returns to Husky Stadium in 2026 with seven home games, including four Big Ten matchups and the Boeing Apple Cup. Fans can look forward to new experiences, enhanced gameday traditions and updates designed to make the Husky Stadium experience better from arrival through the final whistle.
